models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (Apple Silicon, TensorFold / oMLX / mlx-serve speculation comparison)
models.why: Three Mac inference engines with the same Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit weights and the same drafter land within a few tok/s of each other on an M4 Max: the engine's speculative-decoding implementation, not its raw decode loop, is what separates them (188 tok/s with drafting on, ~29-31 tok/s with it off).

engines.quant: Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit, speculative decoding (drafter) ON, thinking OFF, median of 2 runs; workload breakdown Numbers 154 / JSON 146 / Code 114 / Story 51 tok/s
Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit, oMLX 0.7.0, speculative decoding ON, thinking OFF, median of 2 runs; Numbers 146 / JSON 144 / Code 111 / Story 53 tok/s

Qwen3.8-27B 4-bit, mlx-serve 26.10.1 with --no-mtp to force the DFlash drafter (default MTP was ~2x slower on this M4 Max), thinking OFF, median of 2 runs; Numbers 146 / Code 115 / JSON 139 / Story 54 tok/s
